content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in South Bend

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high-school diploma with additional years in role. Review PMI's specific education and hours-worked thresholds, then gather your project documentation before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. The instructor-led course covers the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world scenarios, and exam domains. Complete all sessions on your schedule without leaving South Bend.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After training completion, create your PMI account and submit your official application with proof of education, work experience, and training hours. Pay the PMI examination fee to activate your eligibility window for sitting the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides aligned to the PMP blueprint. Schedule your proctored exam and complete the four-hour, 180-question assessment at a location convenient to you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle through training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and demonstrate ongoing commitment to the profession.
